items.name: Blue Crab Carolina Coast Printed Garment-Dyed Tee
items.alt: Ivory tee printed on the chest with a lifelike painted blue crab with red-tipped claws, hanging from a driftwood branch on a dune beach with sea oats, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A relaxed garment-dyed tee printed with a lifelike painted Atlantic blue crab, a Carolina coast classic. Made to order.
facts: Relaxed fit, offered in sizes L to 3XL (S and M are not offered yet)
Heavyweight 6.1 oz ring-spun cotton, pre-shrunk, double-needle stitching, no side seams
Blue crab illustration printed on the front chest, not embroidered
